title: ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕ ಕಥಾವಳಿ
author: ಪಂಜೆ ಮಂಗೇಶರಾಯ
description: ಗಡಾಮಂಡಲದ ವೀರರಾಣಿ ದುರ್ಗಾವತಿ, ದೇವಗಿರಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಅಲ್ಲಾವುದ್ದೀನನ ದಾಳಿಯ ಹೊತ್ತಿನ ವೀರಮತಿ, ಡಿಲ್ಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಶಿವಾಜಿ ಬಂದಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದಾಗಿನ ರಜಪೂತ ಕನ್ಯೆ ಶೈಲಿನಿ — ಇತಿಹಾಸದ ಹಿನ್ನೆಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪಂಜೆ ಮಂಗೇಶರಾಯರು ಬರೆದ ಮೂರು ಕಥೆಗಳು. ‘ಸುವಾಸಿನಿ’ ಮಾಸಪತ್ರಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮೊದಲು ಪ್ರಕಟವಾಗಿ ೧೯೪೫ರಲ್ಲಿ ಪುಸ್ತಕರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಂದ ಈ ಕಥೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ದೇಶಾಭಿಮಾನ, ಪ್ರೇಮ ಮತ್ತು ತ್ಯಾಗಗಳು ಹೆಣೆದುಕೊಂಡಿವೆ.

provenance.licenseNote: Panje Mangesha Rao (ಪಂಜೆ ಮಂಗೇಶರಾಯ, 1874–1937) died in 1937 (Wikidata Q17495843; Kannada Wikisource author page ಕರ್ತೃ:ಪಂಜೆ_ಮಂಗೇಶರಾವ್), so the work is public domain in India (life + 60). Text is the Kannada Wikisource transcription of the posthumous 1945 edition (third printing, Baliga & Sons, Mangalore; the stories first appeared in the monthly ಸುವಾಸಿನಿ early in the 20th century), scanned as ಪರಿವಿಡಿ:ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕ ಕಥಾವಳಿ-ಪಂಜೆ ಮಂಗೇಶರಾವ್.pdf; every text page used (ಪುಟ ೧೨–೭೫) is at ProofreadPage quality level 4 ('validated'). The exact ಪುಟ: pages used per story are listed in sources.txt beside this file. Only the author's three stories were taken: the title and printer's pages, the publisher's preface (ಪ್ರಕಾಶಕರ ಮುನ್ನುಡಿ) and the biography of the author written by others, the publisher's list of books, running heads, page numbers, ornaments, a one-word footnote, three English glosses and a bracketed editorial query were dropped; paragraphs were re-joined across print-line and page breaks, and the text was proofread against the scan images 2026-10-07: every story page (scans 12–75) was compared with the print, OCR errors and guessed emendations were set to the printed reading, words and lines missing from the transcription were restored, and plain misprints of the 1945 edition were corrected, all listed one by one in sources.txt.
